upstream_evidence.behavior: TypeError raised inside a validator is no longer converted into pydantic.ValidationError; the TypeError propagates directly.
upstream_evidence.scope_note: The official migration guide states that this applies to validation decorators, including the deprecated V1-style validator decorator still used by the frozen target source.

observations: The proposal widens the accepted dependency range from Pydantic 1.10.x to a range that includes both Pydantic 1.x and 2.x.
The Dependabot PR explicitly says the change permits the latest version and was opened one day after the Pydantic V2.0 release date shown in its upstream release material.
The frozen repository root contains no poetry.lock; an exact-head poetry.lock acquisition returned 404.

Therefore a fresh resolver is not constrained by a committed lock to remain on Pydantic V1, but the exact historical dependency version actually installed by any now-unavailable workflow run is not preserved.
dependency_version_applicability.activation_condition: A Pydantic 2.x version satisfying >=1.10,<3.0 is selected by dependency resolution.
dependency_version_applicability.claim_limit: This evidence establishes that the proposed range admits the affected Pydantic major line; it does not prove which exact Pydantic version historical CI installed.

target_activation.target_behavior: The pre=True Pydantic validator checks handler input and deliberately raises TypeError('should be a str') when the input is not a str.

activation_layers.condition: ConfigLambda validation receives a non-string handler

reasoning_chain: Pydantic V2 changes propagation of TypeError raised inside validators.
The frozen qldebugger source uses a Pydantic validator.
That validator intentionally raises TypeError on a concrete non-string handler condition.
If Pydantic 2.x is resolved and that target branch executes, the externally observable exception class can differ from Pydantic V1 behavior.

bounded_finding.statement: The upstream Pydantic V2 TypeError-propagation change has an exact target-owned activation surface in frozen qldebugger source, conditional on resolving Pydantic 2.x and executing the non-string handler branch.
not_established: historical exact Pydantic version exercised by CI
whether the non-string handler branch was exercised by visible tests
whether the exception behavior is part of a maintainer-supported external contract
